verdict.rationale: Inngest's core model is event-driven functions triggered declaratively by app events, webhooks, or crons, with built-in fan-out where one event can trigger multiple functions, plus wait-for-event and invoke for composition. Community reports confirm real-world use for queue/trigger/scheduling workloads working reliably. Missing for 10: explicit documented example showing one single event triggering multiple distinct functions simultaneously (fan-out) rather than inferred from the event-trigger model, and more independent verification of webhook ingestion at scale.
